create_dummy_frame: create a dummy video frame with a moving circle and corner labels for visualization
visualize_roll: visualize roll augmentation by generating and saving a GIF of augmented frames
run_roll_visualization_cli: run the roll visualization CLI to generate a GIF at a specified output path
apply_roll_augmentation: apply roll augmentation to video frames and trajectory data using RollAugmentation
generate_augmented_gif: generate an augmented GIF by stacking dummy frames, applying augmentation, and saving with imageio
